name: Premarket equity dump 4am
prompt:
Weekdays 4:00 ET (true premarket). NEVER gate equity dumps to the 9:20/9:25 MFF Discord arm.

1) Check memory / standing CoS or user orders for any equity dump (e.g. flatten X shares of TICKER at live bid).
2) If NO dump is ordered: stay quiet and exit — do not message.
3) If a dump IS ordered: sell on Agentic at live bid immediately (even at $1 unless halt or absurdly wide — then ping CoS/user and wait). Report fill after. Standing rule: do not hold microcaps over weekends.
4) Do not open Discord. Do not run MFF checklist. Equity dump only.
